name: @censync/hh
description: Humanized Hash: a small deterministic picture of a blockchain address, a public key or a hash, made to catch address poisoning and clipboard substitution
author: Dmitry Mandrika (https://censync.com)

scripts.prepack: npm run clean && npm run build
